applyTo: "src/EncDotNet.Iso8211/**,tests/**/Iso8211*.cs"
---

# ISO 8211 editing rules

When modifying `EncDotNet.Iso8211`:

- Load the `iso8211` skill before proposing non-trivial changes.
- This is a published package that EncDotNet.S100 uses for S-101, S-401 and
  S-57 data. Keep it product-agnostic and treat public API changes as
  breaking; say so in the PR description.
- Parse with `ReadOnlySpan<byte>` on hot paths. Binary values are
  little-endian.
- Keep the reader and writer symmetric: a change to one needs the matching
  change to the other and a round-trip test.
- Build test input in memory with `Iso8211DocumentBuilder`; never commit real
  chart files.
